Fujimori Kogyo Co., Ltd..event: Changed corporate name to ZACROS Corporation
Fujimori Kogyo Co., Ltd..evidence: According to official corporate updates and stock exchange profile information, Fujimori Kogyo Co., Ltd. officially changed its name to ZACROS Corporation in October 2024, and operates on the website www.zacros.co.jp. The company offers medical-grade films, including cyclic polyolefin non-interactive (NI) films, for pharmaceutical blister packs, sachets, and IV bags.

SABIC Innovative Plastics.event: reorganized and merged into standard SABIC business units (Chemicals, Polymers, and Specialties)
SABIC Innovative Plastics.evidence: SABIC dissolved the Innovative Plastics business unit at the end of 2015, reallocating its commodity products to its Chemicals and Polymers units and its remaining solutions to a newly created Specialties unit (Press Release). SABIC continues to serve the healthcare market, offering polyolefins like polyethylene and polypropylene used in medical films and healthcare packaging (Company Website).

Seacera Polyfilms Sdn Bhd.event: acquired by Scientex Packaging Film Sdn Bhd
Seacera Polyfilms Sdn Bhd.evidence: News and stock exchange reports from 2013 confirm that Seacera Polyfilms Sdn Bhd was acquired 100% by Scientex Packaging Film Sdn Bhd for RM40 million. The company manufactured biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) films for general packaging rather than medical-grade films defined in the market scope.

Enzpire Industry Co., Ltd..evidence: The company is actively operating as an innovative flexible packaging manufacturer registered in Bangkok, Thailand according to the Ministry of Industry database and corporate registries. According to its official website, it manufactures end-user medical device sterilization packaging films (LiPore) rather than the raw medical-grade polymer material resins specified in the market scope.

ExxonMobil Chemical Company.evidence: According to the official company website, ExxonMobil Chemical (now under ExxonMobil Product Solutions) manufactures medical-grade polymers, including polyethylene, polypropylene, and EVA polymers, used in healthcare applications such as medical packaging and films.

Leyo Polymer.evidence: The company's official website confirms it is an active manufacturer of thermoplastic elastomer compounds based in Suzhou, China. It offers medical-grade TPU and other TPE resins applicable to the medical and packaging industries.

Ningbo Xiaoda Plastic Co., Ltd..evidence: Trade exhibitor registries for CHINAPLAS 2026/2027 and local trade events verify that the company is an active manufacturer. According to its official trade profiles, it produces medical-grade PVC pellets and compounds for tubing, which falls outside the scope of suppliers providing film-grade raw polymer resins or materials specifically for medical films.

Shenzhen Career Industrial Co., Ltd..evidence: Trade directories and company records verify Shenzhen Career Industrial Co., Ltd. exists and produces the 'Hopefinder' brand of medical compounds. Its website (hopefinder.cn) highlights its range of medical polymer materials, including medical PVC compounds, TPE granules, and medical films.

Shriram PolyTech Ltd.evidence: The company's existence and active operations are verified by Indian B2B directory listings and its official product website showing it is a manufacturer of PVC compounds based in Gurugram. However, its product portfolio focuses strictly on PVC compounds and masterbatches rather than the polyurethanes, polyethylene, polypropylene, or silicone-based polymer materials defined in the market scope.

Sunko Ink Co., Ltd..event: Renamed its Chinese name to Kuo Ching Technology Co., Ltd. (國慶科技股份有限公司) while keeping the same English name
Sunko Ink Co., Ltd..evidence: Official company website announcements and Taiwan corporate registry data indicate that Sunko Ink Co., Ltd. was renamed to Kuo Ching Technology Co., Ltd. in July 2026. The company manufactures URELON® TPU and polyurethane resins applicable for extrusion film production, matching the market landscape.

Unitech Cables.evidence: Unitech Cables is a real operating manufacturer of electrical wires, cables, and PVC compounding materials based in New Delhi, India. According to its official catalog and website, it does not manufacture or supply medical-grade polymer films within the specified market scope.

Xiamen Tingtao Advanced Materials Co., L.evidence: Registry and global trade data indicate that no entity named Xiamen Tingtao Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. exists; similar real entities are Xiamen Tingtao New Materials Co., Ltd. (which exports oils) and Xiamen Tingtao Supply Chain Co., Ltd.
